action_taken: bearing replacement and lubrication system inspection
lessons_learned: Cage fault on SKF22212 conveyor bearing shows FTF dominant frequency with irregular BSF spacing. Kurtosis above 4.5 confirms cage damage. RUL at Stage 3 is approximately 4 days - urgent replacement required. Root cause was grease contamination from external dust ingress through damaged seal. Seal replaced as part of repair.
